summary: A lawyer representing beverage businesses asks the council to let residents vote on a replacement proposal.
realLife: David Rogers identified the soft drink interests he represented and urged members to put the measures before Columbia voters.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: client affiliation and council referral.

turns.what: The lawyer tells clients which ballot language survived.
turns.writesBack: The lawyer can take the case to voters on the authorized question.

turns.what: The lawyer asks the clerk for the petition timetable.
turns.writesBack: Any later petition must qualify on its own.
